rationale: Phase30A intentionally leaky current-season oracle improved exact full-I2 log loss and Brier in every 2022-2026 season, justifying a leakage-safe test.

data_build.current_ytd_rule: Only pitches and terminal PAs completed before each cutoff.
data_build.overall_pitcher_usage: all-inning Statcast pitch counts by pitcher and pitch type
data_build.side_specific_pitcher_usage: I2 Statcast pitch counts by pitcher, actual batter side, and pitch type to match current live architecture
data_build.batter_pitch_response: all-inning terminal-PA expected wOBA by batter and terminal pitch type

reconstruction_gate.rule: Before outcome scoring, reconstruct at least one completed annual arsenal snapshot from raw Statcast and compare pitcher usage and batter pitch-type expected-wOBA against the archived Savant annual leaderboard.
reconstruction_gate.failure_action: Stop Phase30B if reconstruction discrepancies indicate the raw formula is not equivalent enough to the governed arsenal feature.

candidate_policies.name: POOLED_PRIOR_PLUS_YTD
candidate_policies.description: combine prior-season and cutoff-safe current-YTD sufficient statistics using observed support counts; no fitted shrinkage constant

candidate_policies.name: YTD_ONLY_WITH_PRIOR_FALLBACK
candidate_policies.description: use cutoff-safe current-YTD where available, otherwise prior-season/league fallback

selection.method: three-season leave-one-season-out exact full-I2 Under 0.5 log loss; Brier tie-break; parsimony favors PRIOR_ONLY if statistically indistinguishable
selection.promotion_rule: Non-baseline policy must improve both full-I2 log loss and Brier in frozen 2025 validation and must not reverse materially in 2026 replication. No recalibration may mask raw effect.

exclusions: full-season current-year arsenal in historical prediction
note: This phase tests point-in-time arsenal freshness, not removal of the arsenal family; the latter was already rejected after 2026 replication reversal.
